scope: Compiled next start, actual HTTP handlers and separate SQLite; manually authored school content, synthetic sessions/accounts. No mock business handlers. Not Google OAuth, real teacher identity, real students, provider or physical device testing.

checks.name: Real compiled HTTP sends framing/referrer/MIME protection on pages, APIs and error responses
Compiled legacy admin APIs bind reads and mutations to the page account across a cookie switch
Compiled endpoints deny anonymous, cross-origin and forged account binding
Teacher credential approval and explicit organization/class creation use persisted handlers
Hashed invite joins the intended class; replay is idempotent and tenant reads are isolated
Manual question draft requires teacher review and cannot be assigned unreviewed
Student payload omits answer keys, explanation, internal rubric and roster
Submission is self-bound and auto grading remains hidden until teacher confirmation/publication
Compiled grade history preserves published versions while a reviewed regrade remains private
Compiled retake requires acknowledgement, preserves root history and hides questions before opening
Compiled outcome and attempt summaries are administrator-only, account-bound and honest about unknown cost
Draft announcements stay private; published class notice/calendar are scoped and exports authorized
Teacher/student pages render compiled authenticated HTML; backup and restored teaching rows remain intact
Compiled file routes enforce cookie/captured-account/origin/body limits before accepting bytes
Compiled teacher file ACK persists one exact object, retries safely and advances preview revision
Compiled lesson publication releases reference metadata and bytes while teacher-only files stay private
Compiled assignment receives pending image, DOCX and PPTX without claiming submission
Compiled submit transaction rejects another student's file then binds own three files after server ACK
Compiled uploaded bytes survive real SQLite backup/restore with immutable submission metadata

backupRestore.scope: Separate restored SQLite file; not off-host hosting disaster recovery.

fileAcceptance.mode: Compiled HTTP + actual cookies and isolated SQLite; synthetic authored Office packages validate storage/type, not full Office rendering fidelity

connectedBrowserAcceptance.scope: Actual browser form/client + compiled HTTP/SQLite; synthetic JWT sessions, no intercepted business API
